h: Met Police reportedly forwards a letter about Meghan's father to the Sussexes' office
p: London's Metropolitan Police has reportedly passed on a letter containing allegations about Thomas Markle Sr. to the office of the Duke and Duchess of Sussex. The contents of the letter have not been made public.
more: The report says the force acted as a forwarding step
Neither side has publicly commented in detail
